---
title: "Bond Films"
---

This page looks at how the revenue of James Bond films changed over time. In @fig-bond-revenue, it shows the revenue of each Bond film by release year.

::: {#c65d49c0 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
bond = bond.sort_values("year")
```
:::


::: {#cell-fig-bond-revenue .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"], marker="o")
plt.xlabel("Release Year")
plt.ylabel("Revenue (million USD)")
plt.title("James Bond Revenue Over Time")
plt.show()
```
